group_assessment.weighting: An Italian endocrinology and bone-metabolism group (Siena, Milan, Udine, from the affiliations) writing a narrative review with a protocol proposal; review, not a primary data group; not a WWOX group. SUBSTITUTE for the bone, calcium and vitamin D axis (class level, not WWOX evidence). The tabulated cohort figures are weighed above the abstract and conclusion framing, and the review's own internal inconsistencies are recorded.

entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (substitute, bone/calcium axis). The authors conclude that no adequately powered human study can yet say whether ketogenic therapy helps or harms bone.
entries.snippet: at present there are no human clinical studies with adequate powerful experimental design to definitively determine if subjects under KD therapies can derive positive/negative effects on bone health.
